acceptedAnswer.text: Shilika Jain is a senior fractional PR operator for Web3, AI and cybersecurity founders. Six years of practice. 50+ protocols placed in Tier-1 outlets including Forbes, CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block, Blockworks and AI Magazine. Currently leads PR & partnerships at Myosin, a growth-marketing DAO. Previously built CoinMarketCap's APAC PR function from the ground up. Operates across India, Singapore, Korea, Japan, Vietnam and the United Arab Emirates. Direct line to 200+ vetted Web3 KOLs.

Shilika runs a fractional PR practice — a senior operator embedded inside a founder's team, with the bandwidth and accountability of a retainer agency but without the layered junior account-handler stack. Engagements typically cover Tier-1 placements, founder profiling and op-ed ghostwriting, KOL waves, APAC localisation, token launch and TGE communications, and category-creation narrative work for AI and DePIN founders.

mainEntity.name: Which publications has Shilika Jain placed founders into?

acceptedAnswer.text: Named outlets across the 50+ protocol portfolio include Forbes, CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block, Blockworks, AI Magazine, Bitcoin Magazine, Benzinga, CryptoSlate, The Defiant, Yahoo Finance, CryptoDaily UK, CryptoNews, CryptoPotato, NFTNow, Inc42, YourStory, Business Today, Economic Times, e27, BloomingBit (Korea), CryptoTimes JP (Japan), ChainCatcher (China), Jinse (China), HackerNoon and Binance Square. Headline campaigns include Gaia AI in Forbes (Cloris Chen, Dec 2024), RARI Foundation across 11 Tier-1 placements at mainnet, MANTRA Chain in CoinDesk on the Middle East RWA angle, Fluence Network in CoinDesk Opinion on DePIN, and Web3Auth in Blockworks and CoinDesk Protocol via the Google Cloud Firebase story.

mainEntity.name: Where is Shilika Jain based and where does she operate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Based in India, operating across APAC (Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Singapore, India), the Middle East (Dubai and the broader UAE), and the United States. Campaigns are routinely run across multiple regional press tracks in parallel — a home-market exclusive plus a crypto-native track plus a Western tier-1 anchor. The APAC reach was built directly: CoinMarketCap's APAC PR function under Shilika's tenure shipped weekly launches across the region.

mainEntity.name: What companies has Shilika Jain worked with?

acceptedAnswer.text: A non-exhaustive headline list: Gaia AI, RARI Foundation, MANTRA Chain, Fluence Network, Web3Auth (Torus Labs), Bullieverse, NEAR Foundation, Ripple, Stellar Foundation, Gnosis Guild, Liquity, Aragon, Zilliqa, Polygon, OKX, Animoca Brands, Solana Saga, ParaSwap, Rootstock, Stader Labs, WalletConnect, Reown, RabbitX, Magna, Elastos, Legion. The portfolio spans Layer 1s, RWA tokenization, DePIN, MPC wallet infrastructure, NFT royalty enforcement, Web3 gaming, AI agents, and DeFi.

Six years across crypto, Web3 and AI communications. Currently Head of PR at Myosin, a growth-marketing DAO, since 2023. Previously APAC PR & Partnerships at CoinMarketCap (2021 to 2023), where she built the regional comms function and shipped launches every week. Earlier marketing lead roles at Momentum6 and Bloom360. Ongoing freelance contributor at CryptoDaily UK with a verified byline page. Speaking history includes Binary Summit Bangkok, India Blockchain Week 2024, EpicWeb3 Summit, and the Web3 Conf Goa Women in Web3 panel.

mainEntity.name: How do you book Shilika Jain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Book a 30-minute teardown directly at https://calendly.com/shilikajain/30min/. The first call is a free positioning audit: what story you are sitting on, which outlets it actually fits, and which playbook (launch sprint, founder profiling, category creation, regional rollout) is the right fit. Engagements typically start at $5,000 to $12,000 per month for fractional retainers, with launch sprints stacked at $15,000 to $40,000. Productized content offers (Founder Essay Package $3,500, Whitepaper Sprint $9,500, Op-Ed of the Month $2,500/mo) are listed on the content writing service page.
